payload.reason: The evidence discusses the lack of actual exposed MIS 5e facies in synthetic well logs compared to preserved fossil reef facies, indicating a preservation bias and limitations in understanding the geological record.

claims.text: Actual exposed MIS 5e facies are lacking in synthetic well logs, despite preserved fossil reef facies being present at Lembetabe.
The preservation bias in the geological record affects the understanding of MIS 5e sequences, as significant lithological sections may be missing.
Different modeling scenarios show varying degrees of LIG reef preservation, indicating that some scenarios may not capture the full extent of MIS 5e facies.
